name: @lendora/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Lendora (common + identity + credit domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle applications --output src/.bundled/applications.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle applications --output src/.bundled/applications.json && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.json && redocly bundle referrals --output src/.bundled/referrals.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle referrals --output src/.bundled/referrals.json && redocly bundle early-warnings --output src/.bundled/early-warnings.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle early-warnings --output src/.bundled/early-warnings.json && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.json && redocly bundle audits --output src/.bundled/audits.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle audits --output src/.bundled/audits.json
